properties.abstract: A panoramic tour full of contrasts: shaded forest paths alternate with open meadows, the roar of the Sanaspan waterfall and impressive views of the Heidsee lake, mountain chains and the surrounding valleys. The route demonstrates the typical character of the Lenzerheide region in every aspect.
properties.description:
The panoramic tour begins in the centre of Lenzerheide and first takes you on a forest path towards the Sanaspan waterfall. Shaded sections along the way offer views of the surrounding slopes. You can stop by the waterfall before the route continues to the Scharmoin mountain restaurant. The transition into the open landscape of Alp Scharmoin, where the cows of local farmers graze in the summer, begins here.

From Scharmoin, the hike follows the panoramic trail along the side of the Rothorn Valley. This section characterises the tour: far-reaching views of the mountain chain opposite and to the Heidsee lake at the bottom of the valley. The elevation also gives you a clear view into the surrounding valleys and a feeling of vastness. The path gently weaves along to Oberberg, where the landscape changes again, and the route continues towards Uf em Tschugga. You can take a break here before the descent. 

The way back takes you via Parpan and Valbella to Lenzerheide. Open meadows alternate with brief sections of forest. The tour combines scenic diversity with impressive panoramic views and demonstrates the region’s typical character: a mixture of Alpine cultivated landscape and unspoiled sections. Historic elements fade into the background, while the focus is on nature, with its contrasting waterfalls, Alpine meadows and mountain scenery.
properties.title: Panoramaweg Scharmoin
